meta.title: Reluxio — Connect. Sell. Ship.
meta.description: Reluxio connects small and medium merchants and gives you one place to run your shop — orders, inventory, storefront, and shipping.

hero.sub: Reluxio connects small and medium merchants and gives you one place to run your shop — orders, inventory, storefront, and shipping.

trust.heading: Works with the carriers you already trust

showcase.heading: Run everything from one dashboard
showcase.sub: Orders, inventory, storefront, and finances — no more juggling notebooks, spreadsheets, and chat threads.

features.heading: Everything a shop needs. Nothing it doesn't.
features.sub: Built for how small shops actually work.

orders.title: Every order on one timeline
orders.body: From placed to delivered — see status, carrier, and payment at a glance.

inventory.title: Always know what's in stock
inventory.body: Quantities update as you sell, so you never oversell a one-off item.

storefront.title: Your shop, online in minutes
storefront.body: A clean public storefront for your products — no code, no setup fees.

shipping.title: Ship with carriers you already use
shipping.body: Create shipping orders with multiple carriers and track them all in one place.

customers.title: Remember every customer
customers.body: Purchase history and notes, so your regulars always feel like regulars.

finance.title: See your money clearly
finance.body: Revenue, costs, and profit — simple reports that actually make sense.

how.heading: Selling on Reluxio takes three steps

step1.title: Create your shop
step1.body: Sign up and set up your shop profile in minutes.

step2.title: Add products & connect shipping
step2.body: Import your inventory and pick the carriers you work with.

step3.title: Start selling
step3.body: Share your storefront and manage every order from one dashboard.

proof.heading: Merchants are moving with Reluxio
proof.quote1: I used to track orders in three notebooks. Now it's one screen.
proof.quote2: Setting up my storefront took one evening. My customers found it the next day.

pricing.heading: Simple pricing that grows with you
pricing.sub: Start free. Upgrade when your shop is ready for more.

free.name: Starter
free.desc: Everything you need to open your shop.

premium.name: Premium
premium.desc: For shops that are picking up speed.

cta.heading: Bring your shop online with Reluxio
cta.sub: Join the network of merchants who sell, ship, and grow together.
